'''Fef''' was an [[Color/Legends|orange-yellow]] [[Star/Legends|star]] in the [[Fef system/Legends|Fef system]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Fef]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Fefze]], [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the star.
